## Rules
- Minimal changes — only what is required.
- OAuth: use `getCallbackUrl()`; never hardcode `/auth/callback`; password-reset goes to `/no/update-password`; run `npm run oauth:check`.
- PL/pgSQL: `DECLARE` only at top level; `EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS` must include `RAISE WARNING`.
- Caching: landing/app routes use `force-dynamic`; legal pages may use `revalidate = 86400`; catch-all uses `revalidate = 60`.
- Secrets: read from env only; never commit `.env*.local`; run `npm run env:validate` after secret changes.
- Self-correction: pause and verify after >30 lines changed or >5 files touched; run `node scripts/verify/run-all.mjs` when >3 files or >50 lines change.
- End every response with a GO/NO-GO/WIP status block including: files changed, validation run, and next steps.
- After completion: `kg_batch` + `write_diary` + `auto_tag`.
